notes.title: Dev Update #2 - We're alive...
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44645860/4f5df7d59e4ae07a864000a920ace2881668bb83.gif

Hey everyone!

First, sorry for the long silence. I know it's been a while since you heard from us, but rest assured, we’ve been hard at work on Arouse every day. It’s still happening, and we’re giving it everything we’ve got!

It’s been taking longer than expected to finish. The reason for the delay is simple: we want Arouse to be as good as it can be. This is a passion project for us and rushing it would only compromise the quality. We’re committed to making sure the game delivers the exciting, story-driven sex simulator experience that we’ve been working hard to build.

As you might know, it’s just the two of us on the team, and we’re funding everything ourselves, so while things may take a bit longer, we’re determined to bring you something special.

That being said, we're thinking about releasing the game in Early-Access, so we can get it to you sooner and gather your feedback while we continue to improve it. Let us know what you think about that idea!

Thank you so much for your patience and support - it means a lot to us. We can't wait for you to experience the world of Arouse!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Dev Update #1 - News about 'Arouse'
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We Hope you're all doing well! We wanted to drop a quick update on the progress of Arouse, our upcoming video game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44645860/7abf5af172a8d13caa29ec7531f97957f1fb96e7.gif
 

First off, we're alive and kicking. The last months were a wild ride! We were heavily engaged in development, tackling everything from narrative design to gameplay mechanics. Despite being a small team of two with some outside assistance, we managed to make significant strides forward on all fronts. We're currently invested in creating new locations, puzzles, and tweaking character animations. We're also rewriting some parts of the script to ensure it's top-notch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44645860/a55816cae9cbe5dede0ee549b2c8063aa27f2b2a.gif


One of our big focuses lately has been on performance optimization. We want our sexy character creator to give you as many customization options as possible, so we're working hard to ensure the game runs smoothly while still offering many choices.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44645860/0ccf876dbb08e7790039db1fc3a08189828d9070.gif


Now, let's talk about what the story is all about. It's a journey to uncover the truth about the past and discover your destiny. Along the way, you'll get to know your lovely demonic lady companion (more about her soon!) and deepen your relationship with her. You definitely won't regret meeting this horny demon...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44645860/f2686d29a6819de9e2636addfef1fe6bdace9e9f.gif


On a slightly less exciting note – We were a tad too optimistic with our initial release plan. We want to deliver a game that you'll truly enjoy, so we've made the tough decision to push back the release date. But fear not! We're aiming to launch sometime later this year, and we promise it'll be worth the wait.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44645860/63635c71462150a29c18271c245ccaf7c955d6e3.gif


Thanks for sticking with us on this adventure. We can't wait to share more updates with you soon!

Cheers, Red Vibe Studio
